description: Start or reuse one school's policy: its institution-wide rules, worked out once and used by every playlist at that school. Finds the school's captured pages that carry institution-wide rules, then answers hit (the stored policy, its policy_id and status), or stale or miss with a manifest of sections to read with playlist_read: award_types, policies, one page:<capture_file> for each qualifying page, and designations, each with its character count. On stale it also returns the stored policy, so you can see what changed. The server calls no AI model: you read the sections, reason over them yourself, and send the policy with playlist_policy_save.

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
